edges=np.linspace(0.5,10,11)
for i in range(10):
    m=(t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1])
    if m.sum()<6: continue
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),A[m],A[m]**2])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt[m],rcond=None)
    r=dA_dt[m]-X@c
    print(round(edges[i],1),m.sum(),c.round(3),np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2)).round(4), 'tmean',t[m].mean().round(2))
